versions.subject: rule: SysmonEnte usage
versions.detection:
selection_1:
   TargetImage: 'C:\Windows\Sysmon64.exe'
   GrantedAccess: '0x1400'
filter_1:
   SourceImage|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files'
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
selection_calltrace:
   CallTrace: 'Ente'
condition: ( selection_1 and not filter_1 ) or selection_calltrace
versions.spl: (TargetImage="C:\\Windows\\Sysmon64.exe" GrantedAccess="0x1400" NOT (SourceImage IN ("C:\\Program Files*", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\*"))) OR CallTrace="Ente"
